set.reason: This target explicitly asks for the justification of transposition, which is applying the same addition/subtraction to both sides.
set.scope: stating the justification for transposition

set.reason: Perpendicular constructions and uniqueness explain orthogonal projections, but plotting on an existing square grid needs only its given axes. Keep the useful geometry preparation without imposing the full construction workflow.
set.scope: perpendicularity of the two axes

set.reason: Each coordinate axis is a number line with an origin, a direction and a unit. Plotting and reading coordinates is impossible without understanding those three elements of a number line.
set.scope: coordinate axes as two perpendicular number lines

set.reason: Each axis is a signed number line, so plotting signed coordinates uses number-to-position interpretation on it.
set.scope: axes as number lines with negatives

set.reason: Equal corresponding parts of congruent triangles form a useful analogy for reflected figures. Folding coincidence can establish the symmetry properties directly.
set.scope: Equal corresponding parts of symmetric figures

set.reason: One explicit property says the axis perpendicularly bisects the joining segment, so perpendicularity is part of that assertion.
set.scope: The axis perpendicularly bisecting corresponding-point segments

set.reason: The target properties concern figures symmetric about an axis and their corresponding points, requiring reflection symmetry meaning.
set.scope: Properties of symmetric figures and axes

set.description: 成轴对称的两个图形全等，对称点连线被对称轴垂直平分。
set.name: Properties of Reflection Symmetry

set.description: 两条互相垂直、原点重合的数轴构成平面直角坐标系，会根据坐标描点并读出点的坐标。
set.name: The Cartesian Coordinate System and Point Coordinates
set.nameZh: 平面直角坐标系与点的坐标
